perks.name: Tracking Module
perks.description: Adds tracking capability to rockets. Locks onto targets when aiming down sights.

enhanced.description: Adds tracking capability to rockets. Locks onto targets when aiming down sights. Increases blast radius.

perks.name: Quickdraw
perks.description: This weapon can be drawn unbelievably fast.

enhanced.name: Quickdraw
enhanced.description: This weapon can be drawn unbelievably fast. Reload is improved.

perks.name: Overflow
perks.description: Picking up Special or Heavy ammo automatically loads this weapon beyond normal capacity.

enhanced.name: Overflow
enhanced.description: Picking up Special or Heavy ammo loads this weapon even further beyond normal capacity.

perks.name: Air Trigger
perks.description: Increased ammo generation. When airborne, accuracy and reload speed are increased but target acquisition is decreased.

enhanced.name: Air Trigger
enhanced.description: Greatly increased ammo generation. When airborne, accuracy and reload speed are further increased but target acquisition is decreased.

perks.name: Ambitious Assassin
perks.description: Overflows the magazine based on the number of rapid kills before reloading.

enhanced.name: Ambitious Assassin
enhanced.description: Overflows the magazine based on the number of rapid final blows before reloading. Improves reload.

perks.name: Impromptu Ammunition
perks.description: Final blows increase ammo meter progress from all sources for a short time.

enhanced.name: Impromptu Ammunition
enhanced.description: Final blows increase ammo meter progress from all sources for a slightly increased duration.

perks.name: Lasting Impression
perks.description: Rockets attach on impact and detonate after a delay. Increases blast radius and damage.

enhanced.name: Lasting Impression
enhanced.description: Rockets attach on impact and detonate after a delay. Substantially increases blast radius and increases damage.

perks.name: Cluster Bomb
perks.description: Rockets spawn cluster bombs upon detonation.

enhanced.name: Cluster Bomb
enhanced.description: Rockets spawn cluster bombs upon detonation. Blast radius is increased.

perks.name: Reaper's Tithe
perks.description: Multiple simultaneous final blows queue up a stacking damage buff. Timer starts on next weapon fire; final blows extend this timer.

enhanced.name: Reaper's Tithe
enhanced.description: Multiple simultaneous final blows queue up a stacking damage buff. Improved timer starts on next weapon fire; final blows extend this timer.

perks.name: Auto-Loading Holster
perks.description: The holstered weapon is automatically reloaded after a short period of time.

enhanced.name: Auto-Loading Holster
enhanced.description: The holstered weapon is automatically reloaded after an improved short period of time.

perks.name: Aggregate Charge
perks.description: This weapon deals more damage for each elemental debuff applied to the target.

enhanced.name: Aggregate Charge
enhanced.description: This weapon deals more damage for each elemental debuff applied to the target. Damage bonus is increased.

perks.name: Bipod
perks.description: Increases ammo and reserves but reduces damage, blast radius, and reload speed.

enhanced.name: Bipod
enhanced.description: Increases ammo and reserves but reduces damage. Blast radius and reload speed are slightly reduced.

perks.name: Clown Cartridge
perks.description: Reloading this weapon randomly overfills it from reserves.

enhanced.name: Clown Cartridge
enhanced.description: Reloading this weapon randomly overfills it from reserves to an improved degree.

perks.name: Collective Demolition
perks.description:
Collecting an Elemental pickup or destroying a Tangle grants this weapon a stacking period of grenade energy generation on hit. Throwing a Tangle provides additional time.

Elemental pickups include [Solar]Firesprites, [Void]Void Breaches, [Arc]Ionic Traces, [Stasis]Stasis Shards, and [Strand]Strand Tangles.

enhanced.name: Collective Demolition
enhanced.description:
Collecting an Elemental pickup or destroying a Tangle grants this weapon a stacking period of improved grenade energy generation on hit. Throwing a Tangle provides additional time.

Elemental pickups include [Solar]Firesprites, [Void]Void Breaches, [Arc]Ionic Traces, [Stasis]Stasis Shards, and [Strand]Strand Tangles.
